baselines: A naive submission with an empty or incorrect report must fail.

metrics.description: Accuracy of identifying the correct common-mode vulnerability node.
metrics.name: leakage_detection_accuracy

metrics.description: Coverage of the reported failure mechanism against the known fault model.
metrics.name: fault_coverage

metrics.description: Precision of the analysis in pinpointing the exact single point of failure.
metrics.name: hardening_precision

acceptance_criteria: The submitted common_mode_node matches the exact hierarchical name of the shared enable signal.
The submitted failure_mechanism correctly describes the effect of the fault on the counters and the timeout logic.
hidden_spec.ground_truth: Faulting shared_count_en low stalls both counters identically, so their equality monitor remains satisfied while timeout never asserts; independently generated enables are required.

security_requirements.detection_strategy: Check if the submitted report correctly identifies the shared enable signal as the common-mode node.
security_requirements.requirement: The design must not contain a single point of failure in the control path that can disable both redundant counters.

security_requirements.detection_strategy: Check if the submitted report's failure_mechanism description matches the ground truth explanation.
security_requirements.requirement: The failure mechanism must be correctly explained as a fault causing both counters to stall, preventing the timeout from being reached.

hidden_spec.threat_model: A single injected fault on common control defeats both redundant computations and suppresses a security timeout.

constraints: The RTL includes two separate counter instances and a comparison logic block.
A single-bit transient fault model is defined for nets and registers.
The two counters share one enable-generation cone.
The timeout decision logic depends on both counters.
expected_outputs: A valid vulnerability_report.json file in the submission directory.
The report must identify the common-mode node and explain the mechanism of failure.

functional_requirements.requirement: The vulnerability_report.json file must be present at submission/vulnerability_report.json and must be valid JSON.
The report must contain a non-empty string for the 'common_mode_node' field.
The report must contain a non-empty string for the 'failure_mechanism' field.

public_spec.interface: The submission is a JSON report file at submission/vulnerability_report.json. The evaluator reads this file and grades its content against the hidden ground truth. The input artifacts under inputs/ are provided for reference and must not be modified.
public_spec.objective: Analyze the provided RTL design of a dual-counter timeout module. Determine why a single fault on a common control signal can defeat both counters simultaneously, and identify the specific net or register that represents this common-mode failure point.
public_spec.response_format: The submission must be a single JSON file named vulnerability_report.json with the following schema: {"common_mode_node": "<string identifier of the net or register>", "failure_mechanism": "<string explanation of how faulting this node defeats both counters>"}. Both fields are required. The common_mode_node must be a precise hierarchical name matching the RTL source.

title: Common-mode fault in duplicated security counters
